topics.topic: Authoritative transport cutoff for classifying `not_sent` vs `unknown` ('first byte written')
questions: What exact transport event is authoritative for 'first byte written' when the HTTP client buffers, retries socket writes internally, or uses TLS framing?

topics.topic: Handling approval-digest mismatch at send time when a standing grant exists (re-approval vs proceed under grant)
questions: If a previously approved request no longer matches at send time and a standing grant is active, does the kernel have to ask again, or may it send under the grant?

topics.topic: How `stored_value_bytes_max` applies to `many` value ports (whole collection, per element, or both)
questions: For a `many` `value` port, is `stored_value_bytes_max` enforced on the whole array value, on each element, or both?

topics.topic: Output aggregation shape for mapped nodes when declared output is already `many` (nested vs flattened) and validation implications
questions: When a mapped node’s declared output port is already `many`, does collection produce a nested list (one list per map element) or flatten into one list, and how is that validated against downstream `value_schema`/cardinality?
For records where no execution actually ran (`skipped_by_guard`, `upstream_failed`, mapped empty-list synthetic record), what values must `started_at` and `ended_at` take?

topics.topic: Required authority-usage bookkeeping state update during restart recovery of in-flight attempts
questions: On restart recovery of an `in_flight` attempt whose authority was a standing grant or flow activation (not an approval), what exact state change is required for authority usage bookkeeping?

topics.topic: Resume behavior for `service_unreachable` items after grant revocation (mandatory resend vs authority re-check/state change)
questions: On resume, must every `service_unreachable` element always perform a resend attempt, or may authority re-check convert some of them to `owner_approval` without resending?

topics.topic: What bytes are counted for `surface_request_bytes_max` on MCP
questions: What exact byte sequence is measured for `surface_request_bytes_max` on MCP: transport frame bytes, parsed payload bytes, or canonical re-encoding?

topics.topic: Whether filesystem I/O is allowed inside the sandbox exchange directory
questions: Are function implementations allowed to perform filesystem I/O inside the sandbox exchange directory, or should all filesystem I/O be forbidden and data passed only in-memory?

topics.topic: Whether trial `expected_outputs` must be complete/exact across all output ports
questions: When `expected_outputs` is present, must it contain exactly all output ports (no missing, no extra), or can it be partial?

topics.topic: Which HTTP headers are included in the A10 rule 7 `request_digest` computation
questions: Which headers are included in the approval digest: only headers explicitly set by kernel rules (required headers, credential header name, content-type, accept-encoding), or also transport/client-added headers such as Host, Content-Length, User-Agent, and multipart boundary-dependent header values?
